extraction_notes: The datasheet is a family sheet; the US1M entries are the US1J-US1M group values where the table groups variants.
US1M absolute maximum ratings include VRRM = 1000 V, VRMS = 700 V, VDC = 1000 V, IF(AV) = 1.0 A, IFSM = 30.0 A, and Tj/Tstg = -55 to +150 degC (p. 1).
The table also lists maximum reverse current IR2 = 500 uA at VR = VDC = 1000 V and Ta = 100 degC; the 25 degC IR1 value of 5 uA is recorded in specs.reverse_current.
No measured breakdown voltage/current is specified. VRRM and VDC are blocking ratings, not BV/IBV characterization data, so breakdown_voltage and breakdown_current are null.
Fig. 3 US1J-US1M and Fig. 4 Tj = 25 degC and Tj = 125 degC curves were digitized from the supplied PDF at visible plot locations; no points were interpolated between tabulated values.
Fig. 1 is a forward-current derating curve and Fig. 2 is a surge-current-versus-cycles rating curve; neither is included as a diode forward/reverse characteristic curve.
The PDF footer identifies Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd; the top-level manufacturer retains the exact job identity hongjiacheng.
